dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing originating from the mid-section and tapering continuously toward the posterior apex.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and exhibit high bilateral symmetry with no visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity consistent across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Two distinct clusters of localized dark pixels on the anterior dorsal surface; a larger, more concentrated cluster is followed posteriorly by a smaller, less dense cluster. Minor dark-pixel presence at the posterior tip.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the dark mottled clusters and the surrounding white epidermal baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple fine, light-colored linear rake marks across the mid-dorsal plane. A significant dark, longitudinal linear mark is visible on the central dorsal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A thin, linear shadow-casting indentation is visible along the central longitudinal dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark longitudinal scar is present along the dorsal midline; multiple fine intersecting rake marks are distributed across the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dual-cluster pigmentation pattern on the anterior dorsal region.
